items.value: Homall 4 pieces patio furniture sets can easily meet your needs to conduct a conversation in your porch, balcony or other outdoor space. Bathing the sunshine or having a rest after working, it can also enriches your leisure time with your family and friends.

items.value: Made of solid steel and premium PE rattan, Homall outdoor furniture set have a long service life. Ergonomic design armrest and backrest can support your body in a comfortable posture, all designs have been tested by professional laboratories for customers complete safety.

items.label: Multiple Scenarios Using
items.value: Homall classic tempered table, you can put drinks, food, books and other decorations on it. This wicker sets are stylish, easy-to-maintain, and versatile enough as to adapt into your outdoor life like Garden, Patio, Lawn, Deck, Balcony and so on. （Advice to bring the cushion into the house on rainy or snow days to extend the cushion life）
